item.title: FIFA hopes official TikTok broadcasts will bring “relatable perspectives” to World Cup coverage
item.description: World Cup fever has come to TikTok. When the 2026 edition of soccer's quadrennial international tournament kicks off in June, TikTok will serve as FIFA's "Preferred Platform" for live match footage, press conference coverage, training ground updates, and more. This is the first time that FIFA has designated an official Preferred Platform for a World Cup, but soccer's global organizing body is building on its existing relationship with TikTok.
